lines.text: # CCPN — P16 BOUNDED SOURCE RECOVERY R4
I authorize ONE separately versioned, bounded recovery attempt for the P16 M2 neural-source transport failure.
This authorization is limited to source recovery, A-only physiological QC and M2 scientific admission.
The previous R3 source STOP remains immutable.
The original R3 no-retry contract was correctly enforced. R4 introduces separately authorized prospective recovery semantics; do not retroactively classify R3 as successful.
No M3–M5 real model fitting, Development B/E neural evaluation or Final C/D access is authorized by this mission.
Do not substitute another source, dataset version, probe, mouse, unit or stimulus condition.
Verify all source IDs, sizes, ETags, immutable registration files and existing stopped evidence before any live access.
- The incomplete HTTP range and its saved partial bytes
- Original source request and byte ledgers
- All R3 scientific and independent-review verdicts
Existing valid completed A records may be reused only after integrity verification against their frozen source identities and saved evidence.
Do not rerun successfully completed sources merely for convenience.
No partial mouse may be marked physiologically admitted.
No R3 attempt, cache or journal may be erased, overwritten or represented as newly successful.
The fourth source failed during its twentieth candidate spike-time row.
The preceding nineteen candidate captures are frozen historical results.
Before live recovery, register the complete R4 transport and acceptance policy.
First perform a non-neural connectivity and source-identity preflight.
Check that the exact authoritative file remains accessible and its identity, size and ETag agree with the original freeze.
Preserve the existing partial payload and its recorded hash.
Use a new R4-private recovery artifact; do not modify the R3 historical partial file.
Request ONLY the missing suffix range.
- Concatenated full-range length and cryptographic digest
The reconstructed complete range must be supplied to the original scientific reader with exactly the same bytes and logical offsets as an ordinary successful range.
An ETag and response header alone do not certify an incomplete payload.
Permit at most TWO new requests for this specific missing suffix, with a bounded delay between attempts.
For future newly encountered transport timeouts, permit at most two requests for the exact required range, subject to:
- At most two recovered transport failures per source
- At most six recovered transport failures across R4
No replacement URL/provider/dataset object, full-file download, whole-source fallback or silent alternate processing version.
If source identity differs, required bytes remain unavailable or the recovery budget is exhausted, STOP_SOURCE.
Do not skip the mouse and silently proceed to later data.
Keep R3's actual resource usage permanently in its historical ledger.
Authorize a separate R4 recovery budget:
- Maximum 8 GiB newly transferred source payload
- Maximum 512 MiB newly transferred per source
- Maximum 1 MiB per HTTP range request
- At most four concurrent workers, with sequential recovery preferred
- One new maximum 48-hour R4 source-stage wall deadline
The 48-hour R4 deadline is a new prospective authorization, not a rewriting of the elapsed or stopped R3 clock.
Within R4, the deadline may never reset between phases, sources or worker restarts.
Retain independent historical, R3 and R4 usage totals.
No new optimizer budget is activated.
Before touching any of the remaining twenty-four sources:
1. Verify the preserved nineteen completed candidate captures.
2. Recover and authenticate the exact missing range.
3. Complete the interrupted twentieth candidate under the frozen reader rules.
4. Continue only the previously unexecuted candidate rows for the original fourth source.
5. Perform all original source integrity and A-only physiological checks.
6. Independently review the complete fourth-source result.
Do not admit the mouse until its complete mandatory source and physiological conditions pass.
If this recovery fails, end R4 immediately with a truthful STOP report.
Do not switch to an easier FC source or another BO mouse.
Only after the fourth source passes its required source-integrity review, continue the twenty-four originally unattempted sources in their frozen sequence.
- Original source-curated support and known invalid masks
- Exactly eight qualified units selected by the frozen numeric-ID policy
Do not perform new physiological ranking with B or E observations.
Do not concatenate ISI intervals across presentation gaps.
Do not turn absent optional source annotations into proof of artifact-free neural recording.
Provider whole-session unit curation remains an upstream sampling frame.
Only A neural arrays may be exported for the currently authorized scientific preparation.
Do not use B/E outcomes for source, unit or hyperparameter selection.
No Final neural source may be opened.
At least 14 admitted independent mice overall.
All counted mice must have eight qualified local VISp units and all required A/B/E metadata coverage.
- Treating candidate units as admitted animals
- Dropping a mandatory source-integrity failure as ordinary biological attrition
If a fully verified original source yields genuine physiological exclusion, retain that exclusion and its evidence.
Every original Development source must have a complete, defensible terminal disposition before the cohort-level decision.
If the final cohort misses 14/3/10, return DATA_INSUFFICIENT under the frozen design.
If an essential source failure persists, return STOP_SOURCE.
No model fitting follows either result.
The handoff may reference the frozen numerical policies and production requirements.
It must NOT implement real models, activate optimizer attempts, perform B selection or access E neural outcomes.
Model fitting requires a subsequent separately authorized mission.
Run meaningful focused transport and source regressions, including:
Provide saved-only PowerShell reproduction of retained evidence.
Do not claim saved-only replay independently reproduces unavailable private raw arrays.
Commit only authorized new R4 evidence and implementation changes to origin/test.
Verify actual remote SHA and changed-file identities.
M2_SOURCE_AND_PHYSIOLOGY_PASS does not constitute a predictive scientific result.
STOP AFTER VERIFIED M2 HANDOFF OR A DOCUMENTED BLOCKER.
